summary: Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K attaching a Seventh Amended and Restated Distribution Agreement with Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. and a related Calculation Agency Agreement with Scotia Capital Inc., both dated October 1, 2026. The agreement updates the bank's US senior notes distribution program, appointing SCUSA as agent for soliciting offers and allowing principal purchases via separate terms agreements. This is a routine shelf/distribution program maintenance filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or close date are stated. Watch only for future senior note takedowns under the program.
